name: express-mysql
description: Node.js Express API with TypeScript, Prisma (MySQL), JWT authentication (register/login/refresh/logout) with refresh token rotation, user/admin roles, the same middleware stack as the Express template, Vitest + Supertest tests and a production Dockerfile. Use with Docker MySQL for local development.

included: Prisma ORM with MySQL and an initial migration
JWT authentication (register, login, refresh, logout, /me; refresh tokens can't authenticate)
Refresh token rotation with reuse detection (hashed refresh_tokens table, family revocation, logout)
User roles (user/admin): listing, reading other users and POST /users are admin-only; set-role script for the first admin
Dockerfile (node:22-slim multi-stage, non-root, production deps only, /health healthcheck)
Vitest + Supertest tests incl. auth (in-memory Prisma fake, no database/Redis needed)
Redis client (node-redis), optional via REDIS_URL (gpp's MySQL compose has no Redis service)
